p.src: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David.

en: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David.

p.src: 1  Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

en: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
u.src: 1  Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

p.src: 2  From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

en: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
u.src: 2  From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

p.src: 3  For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

en: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
u.src: 3  For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

p.src: 4  I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

en: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
u.src: 4  I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

p.src: 5  For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

en: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
u.src: 5  For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

p.src: 6  You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

en: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.
u.src: 6  You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

p.src: 7  He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

en: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
u.src: 7  He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

p.src: 8  So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

en: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
u.src: 8  So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
